claims.claim: Discrete-ordinates solver reproduces canonical 1-D/void benchmark profiles within declared tolerances
claims.applicability: 1-D slab and nested-cube geometries at the committed multigroup data; pass/fail is per the recorded tolerances, and documented ray-effect discrepancies stand as findings, not failures
limitations: deep-field ray effects are a recorded limitation of the discrete method, not evidence against it

claims.claim: Component-dose computation agrees with continuous-energy Monte Carlo on the layered head phantom
claims.applicability: the committed phantom, spectra, and tally grid of the intercomparison entry; not a general accuracy claim
limitations: single geometry; no voxel-resolution claim beyond the comparison grid

claims.claim: Transport/dose chain reproduces published FiR-1 phantom dose-depth data within declared uncertainty
claims.applicability: the published FiR-1 K63 beam in the committed phantom geometries, at phantom depth resolution
limitations: in-air beam model is fit to published in-phantom data; end-of-range and surface regions carry stated caveats

claims.claim: Scenario-based robust weight optimization converges on the declared worst-case objective
claims.applicability: the linear penalty/objective forms the scenario optimizer supports; nonlinear biological objectives are not established
limitations: a research scenario optimum is not a certified dose bound; unsupported machine deliverability constraints remain unassessed

claims.claim: Cell microdosimetry corrections reproduce Sato (2018) parameterizations for BPA/BSH compounds
claims.applicability: the published compound/parameter domain; microdistribution models remain literature-parameterized
limitations: single literature basis; independent microdosimetric measurement is external

claims.claim: Prompt-gamma reconstruction matches the BeNEdiCTE/LENA-class literature geometry
claims.applicability: the committed literature geometry at its declared quadrature resolution — not sub-centimeter imaging
limitations: the two-vial negative control stands; no spatial-resolution claim beyond the declared response

claims.claim: Joint uncertainty propagation preserves shared/correlated sources across beam targets
claims.applicability: declared joint/0.1.0 inputs — analytic two-field fixtures and ensemble paths within the declared source scope
limitations: source covariance relies on declared inputs; real facility covariance evidence is external

claims.external_requirement: an independent institution reproducing benchmark/intercomparison cases outside this repository's release channel

limitations: no clinical TPS equivalence, commissioning, or regulatory readiness is claimed anywhere in this repository
claims.external_requirement: qualified-partner program with intended-use definition, facility measurements, human review, and jurisdiction/standards review

claims.claim: Prospective partner phantom run with recorded interruptions and independently measured dose
claims.external_requirement: partner facility run with raw delivery export + independent dosimetry

absent_records: per-case data-license declarations on catalogue entries (verify reports them as warnings)
no real delivery-log formats — only the synthetic CSV import contract exists
no per-study joint covariance in the biological evidence library (sources don't report one)
no release/regression record index beyond the repository history itself
no institutional review, audit trail, or clinical-usability record
